div.head: I Cn 6.3
div.ab: And æghwylc Cristen mann eac for his Drihtenes ege unrihthæmed georne forbuge ⁊ godcunde lage rihtlice healde.
And æghwylc Cristen man eac for his Drihtnes ege unrihthamed georne forbuge ⁊ godcunda lage rihtlice healdæn.
And æghwilc Cristen man eac for his Drihtenes ege unrihthæmed georne forbuge ⁊ godcunde laga rihtlice healde.
Et omnis Christianus pro timore sui Creatoris iniustum concubitum uitet et Dei legem teneat.
And æghwylc Cristen mann eac for his Drihtenes ege unrihthæmed georne forbuge ⁊ godcunde lage rihtlice healde.
And æghwylc Cristen mann eac for his Drihtenes ege unrihthæmed georne forbuge and godcunde lage rihtlice healde.
All Christian men likewise through the fear of God shall strictly avoid illicit unions and duly observe the laws of the church.
And for fear of God, every Christian must diligently avoid unlawful intercourse and rightly uphold the divine law.
Und auch jeder [andere] Christenmensch meide aus Furcht vor seinem Herr[gott] willig gesetzwidrigen Beischlaf und halte gesetzlich geistliche Rechtsordnung(en?).
And let every [other] Christian man also, for fear of his Lord, eagerly avoid unlawful intercourse and keep the law(s?) of God rightly.
